notes.title: New Version Out! Patch Notes – v1.0.0.0 (2025)
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce a new major update! With the launch of [i]Ukko & Guará: Stellarbound[/i] on consoles, we’ve made several improvements across all platforms. To reflect these enhancements, the game version has been updated to [b]v1.0.0.0 (2025)[/b].[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Added a [b]Best Time Leaderboard[/b] to track your fastest playthroughs of the main game[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a [b]Three-Star Scoring System[/b] to reward level perfection[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous [b]visual and effects enhancements[/b] for a more immersive experience[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]gamepad support and responsiveness[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Game design refinements for better flow and challenge balance[/p][/*][*][p]General [b]bug fixes[/b] and stability improvements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Big news coming to Ukko & Guará: Stellarbound!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that [b]we're working on a significant update for Ukko & Guará: Stellarbound[/b], alongside the launch of the game for [b]PlayStation and Xbox[/b]!

We want players on all platforms to have the best experience possible. That’s why all improvements from the console versions will also arrive on the Steam version!

[h3]Here’s what’s coming:[/h3]
[list]
  [*][b]Leaderboards[/b][/*]
  [*][b]Visual improvements[/b] with more refined graphics and animations[/*]
  [*][b]Performance optimizations[/b] for smoother gameplay[/*]
  [*][b]Bug fixes and general adjustments[/b][/*]
  [*][b]Puzzle and gameplay balancing[/b][/*]
  [*][b]Enhanced UI/UX[/b], with clearer and more intuitive menus[/*]
  [*][b]Graphic polish and artistic updates[/b][/*]
  [*]And other surprises we’re working on with care![/*]
[/list]

We’re putting a lot of love into this new phase and can’t wait for you to enjoy everything that’s coming.

Thank you for being part of this magical journey with Ukko and Guará!

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.2.1)
notes.content:
- Improvements to the game experience: animations, effects, user interface, and controls
- Implementation of the options menu in the pause menu
- Some game interface and gameplay fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.2)
notes.content:
Various improvements, fixes, and adjustments have been made in version 1.2. See below:

[list]
[*]     Implemented compatibility with Switch Pro controller
[*]     3 new languages added: Russian, French, and Korean
[*]     Fixed minor issues and general adjustments
[*]     Minor visual improvements and adjustments
[*]     Save game algorithm improvements
[*]     Improvement: smoother aiming with the gamepad
[*]     Improvement: button to facilitate gameplay for young children
[*]     Improvement: scroll down the level selection screen when navigating with controls
[*]     Improvement: added character health bar tutorial
[*]     Improvement: confirmation of progress loss when starting a new game
[/list]

notes.title: (Patch Notes v1.1) Game controllers compatibility improvements
notes.content:
We have worked on improvements for game controllers compatibility, mainly Xbox and PlayStation controllers. The game now correctly displays button labels based on the current game controller in use.

Patch Notes v1.1
- Added compatibility to PlayStation controllers (DualShock 4 and DualSense)
- Improved compatibility with Xbox controllers
- Added button labels to the UI for game controllers
- Game tutorials improvements
- Minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Many improvements so far and plans for future updates
notes.content:
Since the game's launch, we have continuously brought updates with improvements, new features, and platforms. In 2024, we added 2 new official platforms (Mac OS and Linux + Steam OS). We also introduced Steam Cloud to keep your game progress saved in the cloud and made some fixes and adjustments.

Our goal is to continue supporting the game by adding more features, improvements, and fixes. We have put a lot of love and work into this project and want to see more players enjoying solving the puzzles while trying to reunite our heroes Ukko and Guará. We invite players to participate in discussions, suggest updates, report bugs, and share their opinions about the game.

Below you can find a summary of the updates since the launch:

[list]
[*]     Availability for Linux + Steam OS
[*]     Availability for Mac OS
[*]     UI fix in the main menu for players using game controllers
[*]     Steam Cloud now available for game progress
[*]     Visual effects improvements
[*]     UI fixes
[*]     Localization fixes (translations)
[*]     Minor improvements and bug fixes
[*]     Language detection system fix
[*]     Localization fixes for Chinese
[*]     Added localization for Japanese
[*]     Gameplay adjustments
[/list]
